## EditorPanelsExtensionsBuilder.register property

Registers a new panel for editors.

**Signature:**

```typescript
register: <TItem extends IdentifiableObject = IdentifiableObject>(item: EditorPanelsExtension<TItem>) => this;
```

## Remarks

This method only registers the panel and does not automatically make it visible in the application. To add the panel to the application, use [EditorPanelsExtensionsBuilder.config](./extensions.editorpanelsextensionsbuilder.config.md)<!-- -->.
